low_power_uart.label: LPUART1 on PB10/PB11 (AF1) with RS-485 driver-enable on PB1 (AF6) — morpho header expectation, NOT a fitted transceiver; no RS-485 device is on a Nucleo. PB10/PB11 rather than LPUART1's PA2/PA3 (AF6) on purpose: those are the SAME pins the ST-Link VCP uses for usart2's debug_uart, so the obvious route for this block is the one route it cannot have on this board. 115200 and not 9600 because the LPUART's kernel here is PCLK (RCC_CCIPR's reset selection, the only thing alloy's clock_node can express) and its divisor window makes 15626 baud the slowest reachable rate at 64 MHz — 9600 needs LSE, which this data cannot select. Asking for it is a compile error, not a wrong baud.

encoder.label: TIM3_CH1/CH2 on PA6/PA7 (Arduino D12/D11, AF1) — header expectation, no encoder is fitted on the Nucleo. A DIFFERENT timer from led_pwm's TIM2 on purpose: one block cannot be both.

bridge.label: TIM1 three-phase complementary outputs on the CN10 morpho header: CH1/CH1N PA8/PB13, CH2/CH2N PA9/PB14, CH3/CH3N PA10/PB15, BKIN PB12 (all AF2). HEADER EXPECTATION, NOT A FITTED POWER STAGE — no inverter is on a Nucleo. The dead time is what an IR2110-class gate driver wants and is a PLACEHOLDER until a real board states its own; nothing here has driven a transistor. A DIFFERENT timer from led_pwm's TIM2 and encoder's TIM3 on purpose: one block runs one personality.

spi.label: SPI1 on PB3/PB4/PB5 (morpho CN10) — keeps LD4/PA5 free

tick.label: TIM6 as a bare periodic time base — no pins. TIM6 rather than a general-purpose timer on purpose: TIM2/TIM3 are already spoken for by led_pwm and encoder, and a basic timer has nothing else to be. It is also one of only three blocks on this die whose CR2 has an MMS field, so it can drive TRGO for the DAC or the ADC.

window_watchdog.label: WWDG on PCLK/4096 — a SECOND dog alongside the IWDG, not a replacement: it also resets on a feed that arrives too EARLY. At the 64 MHz profile it counts to ~524 ms at most, so the window is a loop-rate check and the IWDG stays the long backstop.

nvm.label: last 2 KB flash page (dual-bank: bank2 page 127)

fs.label: 32 KB littlefs region (16 pages) carved just below the nvm page

rtc.label: RTC on LSI (~32 kHz), backup-domain calendar

dac.label: DAC_OUT1 on PA4 (also ADC_IN4 — internal loopback readback)
